investigations.title: 1. Recon main()
investigations.subtitle: From Main.lean through the real Horn-skeleton contract circuit

steps.title: Entrypoint & Single Bottleneck Hub
steps.text: Main.lean (12 lines) exports 5 theorems, all routing through one hub module `Supplements.Kernels.MainTheoremsAll` whose dominator subtree covers 175,185 of 175,187 modules (175,184 strict descendants + hub). All 5 theorems collapse to a single master claim: `UpperTheory.EveryCharacter`.

steps.title: Dependency-Injection Architecture Exposed
steps.text: The top proof passes major mathematical engines as hypothesis arguments rather than direct calls: `everyCharacter_of_row (h : Row0b …) : EveryCharacter`. Reading theorem signatures recovers the true logic flow (`Row0b ⟹ EveryCharacter ⟹ RiemannHypothesis`) that file imports obscure.

steps.title: Three-Engine Convergence (`Green ∧ VWin ∧ HypsAlt`)
steps.text: `Top.zero_free_all_of_green_v_win` (`TopPlug.lean`) fuses three independent subsystems — `GlobalTheory.GLq.Green`, `UpperTheory.Top.VWin`, and `_root_.GlobalTheory.Fc.HypsAlt` — to prove `Formalism.HC.ZeroFreeAll` (primitive Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re s > 1/2).

steps.title: Dead Side-Routes Preserved in the Tree
steps.text: Whole-corpus Horn extraction also surfaces alternate/abandoned wiring such as `UpperTheory.Top.plugAll` and `UpperTheory.Lit.everyE₂` alongside `Formalism.MainNotions.ZetaZeroFreeRegion.rh_of`, showing real stratigraphy of how the AI-assisted proof evolved.

investigations.title: 2. TCB X-Ray (51,692 decls)
investigations.subtitle: Real `challenge.ndjson.zst` statement closure — what Mathlib definitions you must trust

steps.title: Exact 51,692-Declaration Statement Closure
steps.text: Streaming Sutherland's `challenge.ndjson.zst` (6,495,712 NDJSON lines) yields exactly 51,692 declaration records: 40,431 theorems (78.22%, kernel-checked) and only 11,261 definitions/inductives/opaques/axioms (21.78%). Following pure definition-to-definition edges shrinks the reading surface to 2,570 definitions.

steps.title: Zero `sorryAx` Leak into Statements
steps.text: Although `challenge.ndjson` contains `sorryAx` (because `Challenge.lean` stubs proofs with `:= by sorry`), DAG tracing confirms `sorryAx` has fan-in 5 — exclusively from the 5 challenge theorem `value` fields, with 0 paths from any statement `type`. The statement closure uses only `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

steps.title: RH vs Dirichlet GRH Delta = Only 470 Extra Declarations
steps.text: `riemannHypothesis` reaches 51,215 declarations (`+2` for `riemannZeta_eq_zero_re` / `RiemannZetaZerosOnLine`); adding all 3 Dirichlet GRH statements adds just 470 declarations (`51,215 + 2 + 470 = 51,687` reachable + `5` unreachable export targets = `51,692`) — dominated by one clean Mathlib analytic-continuation chain: `DirichletCharacter.LFunction` (279) → `ZMod.LFunction` (278) → `HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta` (237) → `hurwitzZetaOdd` → `completedHurwitzZetaOdd` → `hurwitzOddFEPair`.

steps.title: Solving the `con-leche` vs `nanoda` Count Mystery
steps.text: The 969 `inductive` NDJSON records unpack into 969 types + 1,059 constructors + 971 recursors = 2,999 individual constants (53,722 total vs 51,692 NDJSON records). This record-bundling convention directly explains why `con-leche` and `nanoda` report different declaration totals on the exact same `solution.ndjson` export.

steps.title: Elaborator-Bypass Tactics (`kexactB` & Macro Wrappers)
steps.text: `Imports.lean` (8 lines) defines `kexactB` via `Term.elabTermAndSynthesize e none; g.assign ...`, punting definitional equality straight to the C++ kernel to dodge elaborator heartbeat blowups. Found in 50 files directly and 72 files including its `kc%`/`kq%`/`kd%`/`tr_via`/`tr_clause` macros (closest is 6 hops from `Main`). Sound because independent kernels re-check every term [C].

steps.title: Two-Line Tactic Blowup: `lam_copy` (55.2s) & `sigSpan_copy` (40.3s)
steps.text: The two slowest declarations in `con-leche` (`lam_copy` 55.2s, `sigSpan_copy` 40.3s) are short theorems invoking `copy_cases h D D'` on heavily nested `HEq`-linked structures (`D7`/`CopyAll`). `sigSpan_copy` is literally 2 tactic lines (`copy_cases h D D'; exact hs`), yet generates a massive kernel term via chained dependent `subst`.

steps.title: Where the Proof Computes: 5 `lean4lean` Timeout Modules
steps.text: All 5 modules that hit `lean4lean`'s default step limit use `by decide +kernel` for finite small-N prime checks: `ChebyshevPrimeBounds.SmallLoop` (`PI.PC.loop_run`, 35.1s) runs a 131,070-step trial-division sieve with a custom strictness thunk `force`; `DyadicPrimeIntervals.Run1–4` shard a 131,070-step check from h = 2 to 131,072 using `362!` (771 decimal digits) into four chunks (`Run1`: 32,766 steps; `Run2–4`: 32,768 steps each).

steps.title: AI Engineering Artifacts (19,750 Duplicate `Mathlib` Imports & Clones)
steps.text: Beyond 308 duplicate project imports, 19,750 files repeat `import Mathlib` twice! Exact alpha-renamed file cloning groups 4,787 modules into 1,192 clusters (largest = 385 identical `*Statement` wrappers). Meanwhile `PrimeRecip.table_ok` (17.2s, hardcoded prime witness table up to 16,900) sits misfiled inside `AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/DivisorProofs`.

investigations.title: 4. Namespace Reality Check
investigations.subtitle: All 175,187 files mapped — why directory names are an adversarial symbol table

steps.title: One Folder Owns 56.6% of the Entire Proof
steps.text: `Development/AbelianVarietyTheory` contains 99,187 files (8,142,960 lines; 457,031 decls) — 56.6% of all files in the archive. Yet its top actual Lean declaration namespaces are `_root_.GlobalTheory` (39,212), `GlobalTheory.IndefiniteRowSideFullHecke` (14,165), and `GlobalTheory.Mem` (11,592) — p-adic GL_n representation theory, theta chains, and even prime-reciprocal tables!

steps.title: Cross-Library Namespace Drift
steps.text: `Development/AutomorphicSpectrum` (15,147 files) actually declares 62,415 items under `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory`, while `Development/WeilBound` (7,051 files) predominantly populates `PositivityTheory.Rg` and `PositivityTheory.SiegelWeilFormula`. Folder paths reflect historical agent scaffolding, not mathematical layering.

steps.title: Real Structural Cuts: 7 Single-Entry Giants
steps.text: The dominator tree under `MainTheoremsAll` breaks the 175,187 files into 47,060 top-level components: 7 giants ≥1,000 modules (44,980 modules total, led by `RowSrc` at 13,055 modules / 993k lines) alongside 37,001 shared singletons (21.1% of files, 29.4% of lines).

steps.title: Phase 1 Hypothesis Falsified: Trailing Newlines
steps.text: In Phase 1 we noticed `17,549,402 - 17,374,215 = 175,187` and hypothesized every file lacked a trailing newline. Direct byte inspection of all 175,187 files FALSIFIED this: 175,187/175,187 files DO end with `\n` (`trailing_nl_missing = 0`). The +175,187 gap was `len(text.split('\n'))` counting the empty string after the final newline!
